STEP ONE OF THE CATALOGUE

Fill this in, download it, send it back.

This page runs entirely in your browser. Nothing is uploaded anywhere and it does not need internet. Enter your real products, attach the photos you want used, then press Download everything — you get one ZIP file containing the catalogue JSON and every photo, already named correctly. Send that ZIP over and it can be dropped straight into the shop.

Two rules that keep the shop honest: only publish a product when the price is the real one you charge and the photo is one you own. Anything you leave unconfirmed stays a draft and never appears on the public site.

        D · FINISH

        Send it back

        Everything stays on this computer until you send the file

        Press Download everything (top right) for one ZIP containing:

        • catalog.data.json — the catalogue
        • images/<product-slug>-01.jpg — each photo, pre-cropped and named
        • INTEGRATION-NOTES.txt — what you typed below, plus any problems

        This builder is a standalone file. Closing the tab is safe — your work is kept in this browser and reloads next time, but the browser is not a backup: download the ZIP when you are done. Photos are cropped to 4:5 and resized to at most 1600 px tall before being included, so the ZIP stays small.
